details: CONFIRMED that votes still split (result file); PLAUSIBLE that further wording removes it. Project rule
"Quality gate" (flaky test or eval: find the cause, then prove the fix with max(20, ceil(3/p)) clean runs).
The cause analysis is sound for the two phrases, but a residual lean on "A finding that names size + 1 or the
slice but calls it ... correct" remains for answers that name the slice (yes-06) or "at most 2" (yes-03).
Cost of 20 haiku runs of the one case is about $0.24 (measured $0.06 per 5), inside the brief's $1 cap. Size: 30.
evidence: aggregate-result.json: runs 5, errors []; yes--03 votes split in 2 runs, yes--06 in 2 runs; costUsd 0.0601.
rules/quality-gate.md: "prove the fix with at least max(20, ceil(3/p)) clean runs".
failing_case: Haiku, new wording, 5 runs: yes--03 ("page([a,b,c], 0, 2) returns 3 items; a page must hold at most 2") gets
FAIL votes in 2 of 5 runs, yes--06 ("the slice end is start + size + 1, so ... overlaps the next page's first
item") in 2 of 5 runs. Before the fix yes-05 failed 2 of 5 runs (p = 0.4), so ceil(3/p) = 8 and the rule asks for
max(20, 8) = 20 clean runs; the proof is 5 runs and they are not clean at vote level (tally FAIL, see F1).
Expected: a wording under which haiku's tally of measure-off-by-one passes over at least 20 runs (or the item
records that haiku cannot be brought to pass and why).
fix_hint: Run haiku on measure-off-by-one with --runs 20 -j 1; if splits remain, look at what yes-03/yes-06 share with the
FAIL clause (e.g. "the slice", "at most") and reword once more, then re-run 20.
pass_cases: - haiku, measure-off-by-one, --runs 20 -j 1: 0 wrong verdicts, split items <= 1 (tally PASS), on the committed rubric.
- In that run no--12, no--16, no--24 (the answers the removed phrases used to name) are FAIL in every run.
- yes--03 and yes--05 are PASS in every run (the queue item's failing case).
- make.py --check still passes (measure graders byte-equal to the production rubric).
reason: 20-run haiku measure (scratchpad/ob/h20.json, not partial, $0.25) re-tallied by me as PASS: 0 wrong of 480, 1 split item (max 1). Meets max(20, ceil(3/p)) runs. Evidence is a measurement, no test applies.
findings.summary: Quality gate: the trap is reduced, not shown gone: right answers yes-03 and yes-06 still draw FAIL votes from haiku, and the fix rests on 5 runs where the rule asks for at least 20 clean ones
